title: Shisha Cloudz – Red Gummi 100ml
description:
Shisha Cloudz – Red Gummi 100ml
Red Gummi by Shisha Cloudz e-liquids is a real OG in Shisha Flavours.
If you’re looking for an e-liquid that accurately mimics the shisha experience, then look no further than Shisha Cloudz. Their new flavour, Red Gummi, is a delicious and exotic blend of sweet and fruity flavours that will transport you to a faraway land.
The strong red sweetness is perfectly balanced with the candy-like aftertaste, making it a perfect all-day vape. Whether you’re enjoying a relaxing session on the beach or exploring a new city, Red Gummi will make it feel like home.
So if you’re looking for an authentic shisha experience in e-liquid form, be sure to check out Shisha Cloudz Red Gummi. You won’t be disappointed!
Shisha Cloudz e-juices come with 0mg nicotine level and a 70VG/30PG ratio.
Nic Strength
: 0mg
Primary Flavours
: Red Gummies
Bottle Size
: 100ML
PG VG Ratio
: 30PG / 70VG
